No zero check on the destination, so `owner` (MockAggregator.sol:65) can be set to address(0) and every setter on this feed becomes unreachable — the price then freezes at whatever `_answer` (MockAggregator.sol:57) last held while keeps stamping it with the current block time at `ts` (MockAggregator.sol:91).

Owner-only. Because the returned `_round` and answer carry a fresh timestamp (MockAggregator.sol:92), one `peg` call is enough to make the oracle's heartbeat check at `heartbeat` (QuoteOracle.sol:246) pass indefinitely.
